text: Detect the project's stack and existing token files before writing code; NEVER import unrequested external libraries or fonts unless already present or requested.
Define semantic light and dark surface tokens including translucent glass backdrop variables paired with opaque contrast fallbacks.
Body text pairs MUST reach at least 4.5:1 contrast and large headings (>= 24 px or bold >= 19 px), borders and focus rings MUST reach at least 3:1 in light and dark modes.
Typography MUST keep body text >= 16px (line-height 1.5, prose <= 65ch), purposeful weights (400, 500, 600, 700), -0.02em heading tracking and tabular-nums on counters/shortcuts.
Spacing MUST stay on a 4px grid with consistent radius tokens (--r-xs..--r-xl), 1px hairline borders and an explicit --z-* layering scale.
Interactive controls MUST provide >= 44x44px hit targets, tactile hover/active feedback, restrained edge highlights and at most ONE filled primary action per view.
Multi-view or searchable UIs MUST include command-first navigation (Ctrl+K/Cmd+K dialog, keyboard arrows/Enter/Escape and visible kbd hints).
Headers, sliding active indicators, sidebar rails and mobile drawers MUST adapt cleanly without colliding with content or causing horizontal overflow at 390px or 1440px.
Micro-interactions MUST animate transform and opacity only (120ms-240ms) and disable spatial travel under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
Interactive and data views MUST implement default, hover, focus-visible, active/selected, disabled, dimension-locked skeleton, empty filter reset and inline error retry states.
AI prompt and assistant surfaces MUST provide quick-action chips, live streaming/thinking feedback, a stop/cancel trigger and undo/revert controls.
Inline SVG icons and decorative visuals MUST use currentColor or var(--...) with aria-hidden="true" on decorative SVGs, never hardcoded hex attributes.
checklist: All inline SVGs bind colours to currentColor or var(--...) and decorative icons carry aria-hidden="true".

text: Responsive layouts MUST prevent clipped headings or sideways scroll across 390px-1440px viewports and preserve legible script line-heights.
checklist: Titles, grids and multilingual strings wrap cleanly without clipping or horizontal page overflow.

text: Interactive controls MUST use native semantic HTML with visible >= 2px :focus-visible outlines.
CSS-scoped roles (UX_DESIGNER) MUST emit complete stylesheets plus an explicit Markup Handoff Contract; full-stack roles ship complete runnable UI code.
checklist: Role adaptation matched: full runnable UI for engineering or modular CSS plus Markup Handoff Contract for CSS-only roles.

text: NEVER invent fake customer testimonials, fabricated metrics or unrequested product claims.
checklist: No fabricated user metrics or fake social proof appear in generated copy.

text: Refuse requests meant purely for ui-polish, design-system, a11y-audit, copy-tight or figure-craft with a concise redirect sentence.
When browser tools are available, verify rendered HTML at 1440px and 390px in light and dark themes with reduced motion, zero console errors and zero overflow.
checklist: Rendered browser checks at 1440px and 390px pass in light and dark mode with zero errors and zero horizontal scroll.
